def not(value: Box): Box = value.unary_!
def complement(value: Box): Box = value.unary_~
def positive(value: Box): Box = value.unary_+
def negative(value: Box): Box = value.unary_-
def valueMember(value: ValueBox): ValueBox = value.unary_!
